description: Observed during step D real repeated-run retention test: test/zaq/agent/request_inspection_test.exs, default 100-request eviction case. Actual Factory→remote OpenAI stub→Jido→StreamEvents paths; fresh consumer Task per ask; unique real-shaped response IDs. At 32/36 runs, native requests[id].status is completed but strategy status remains awaiting_llm with same active_request_id. Retained native tail includes request_completed followed by llm_completed/checkpoint; next ask can reject busy, and repeated state reads stay stuck through 60s. Distinct from .31.5 until causal evidence establishes any relation. Test remains unskipped; do not reset native state or reduce retention/loop assertions. Native strategy apply_runtime_event base_state reassigns active_request_id for all events and late model completion can reopen status; source hypothesis not fully resolved. Factory request_state incorrectly advertised accepting=true for completed native record; pinned by real regression and locally fixed to require status pending. Remaining native reuse/ordering needs a scoped diagnosis/design before dependency or native-semantic changes; no dependency edited. Action reuse not applicable to diagnostic evidence; future fix must reuse native lifecycle, not add a parallel scheduler/registry. Blocks D native default retention acceptance. No publication authorized.
